title: The evolution of eID. How European markets are scaling in 2026 [Analysis]
summary: Explore how European eID markets are scaling in 2026, with data on app reach, adoption velocity, EUDI Wallet readiness and user demand.
body_markdown:
Last updated: 7 September 2026


For the latest adoption data, see[Where Europe's identity apps actually reach | eID Adoption Race H1 2026](https://authologic.com/blog/eid-adoption-eudi-wallet-deadline-h1-2026) .


In this March report, we check who has made the best use of this time, analysing not only the reach of app downloads among the adult population (App Reach) but, above all, the download dynamics (Velocity) in 2026 and the battle for citizen attention in mobile store rankings (TOP 50 – Top Charts).
